title: Former Minister Anita Radhakrishnan, 6 others acquitted in disproportionate assets case
description: The Principal District and Sessions Judge held that the prosecution had failed to establish the charge that when he was the Minister in the Jayalalithaa-led AIADMK government between 2001 and 2006, Mr. Radhakrishnan had amassed wealth disproportionate to the known sources of his income in his name and in the names of his wife, brothers, and sons
